attempts.attempt: Identify simultaneous recovery from only individual truthful tests and contract outcomes.
attempts.conditional_obstruction: Disjoint and common-capacity worlds can share those observables while having different joint delivery.
attempts.escape: Observe authenticated capacity overlap or run a simultaneous probe.
attempts.status: CONDITIONAL_NONIDENTIFICATION_CONSTRUCTION; NOT A NEW OR UNIVERSAL THEOREM

attempts.attempt: Guarantee joint service-preserving veto exercise using individually tested rights and a fixed shared substitute.
attempts.conditional_obstruction: Concurrent minimum substitute demand exceeds the same finite capacity.
attempts.escape: Provision capacity, stagger genuinely deferrable exercise, preserve disjoint substitutes or relax an agreed continuity constraint.
attempts.status: RESOURCE_CONSTRAINT_WITH_ESCAPES; NOT A BROAD IMPOSSIBILITY CLAIM

attempts.attempt: Recover all operative constraints and causal states from a complete success-only migrated action history.
attempts.conditional_obstruction: Different negative-rule/causal states can generate identical successful transactions.
attempts.escape: Retain independently interpretable abstention reasons, working contrasts or adequate side-channel evidence.

attempts.attempt: A broad triangle claiming privacy minimization, portability and effective correction cannot coexist.
attempts.conditional_obstruction: A specific design deletes narrow proof and loses the challenge forum.
attempts.escape: Minimal selectively revealable commitment evidence plus durable affected-party standing can preserve all three goals in the construction.

attempts.attempt: A broad claim that fixed local effect ceilings cannot coexist with stable cross-institution consequence containment.
attempts.conditional_obstruction: External automatic execution can change consequence reach if absent from the local abstraction.
attempts.escape: A sound protected-effect abstraction may already include counterpart-mediated consequences, or require separate execution consent.

attempts.attempt: Full local deletion, zero third-party disclosure and full retrospective redress conflict if the erased record is stipulated to be uniquely sufficient.
attempts.escape: Independent testimony or selective functional/evidence certificates.
attempts.lesson: Unique-evidence assumptions can create tautology; no general privacy theorem follows.

attempts.attempt: Always fresh asynchronous terms, sufficient local review and jointly binding approval can conflict without a common snapshot.
attempts.escape: Binding snapshots, coordinated renewal or flexible validity requirements.
attempts.lesson: An interval obstruction is not impossibility of human review generally.

attempts.attempt: All vetoes individually viable, shared substitutes fully committed and all vetoes jointly executable can conflict in a finite schedule.
attempts.escape: Capacity-backed complements, releases or independent routes.
attempts.lesson: A contradiction in a chosen resource model is not a new theorem or claim about all authority systems.
